high_level_description: The image depicts a decorative metal wall art piece mounted on a light-colored wall. The artwork is designed to resemble an arched window or a tree with a grid-like structure. At the top of the piece, there are two stylized peacocks facing each other, adding a touch of elegance and symmetry. Below the peacocks, the grid is filled with intricate cut-out designs that appear to represent various human figures engaged in different activities. These figures are depicted in a dynamic and lively manner, suggesting scenes of daily life or traditional activities.
